[b]Büdingen Gazette: HDF Buildup on the White Sea and East Elseyr [/b]

Neudresden - The Republik is establishing one of its biggest military buildups in east Elseyr and the White Sea in decades, including a carrier strike group, a number of military aircraft and a surge in air defense systems. Chancellor Sebastian Vogt said on Wednesday that the military buildup was necessary to defend Republik allies in the region and continued security on the continent. 

Moving to positions within the White Sea, Corzerran and Wuloosya, the HDF combined force includes the NRS Kaiser Maximilian II carrier strike group, over 120 fighter jets, including JA-35s, J-22s, JA-15s, JA-16s, and additional refuelers and cargo aircraft. Early warning aircraft, including E-3s as well as AWACS, have been moved to airbases in Corzerran and Wuloosya. Air defense systems, including the LTAMDS and others, have been moved to defend Republik military assets within the area.

[b]March 1, 2028: Movements in the West[/b]

It was rare that the SCSID summoned Polenne Strømm, they hadnt done so since the summer of 27, however, it was on this day they did.

Arriving into the now familiar briefing room Strømm gave pause as she looked around, the entire defense council and SCSID command council had seated themselves around the table, footage of ships and vehicles splayed on the television screens tha surrounded the room.

Something tells me I am not to like this, she stated, immediately, Menkins, spill it! She commanded.

Menkins choked a little at the sudden sharpness in her voice, literally spilling some of his coffee he stood up with a slight curse, saluting Strømm, a rare move.

Madame Duc, the SCSID is distressed to report significant movements by the Neue Republik into the White Strait towards Wuloosya, he said.

Strømm frowned, Theyre provoking us, what is their move? She asked.

They appear to have moved  the NRS Kaiser Maximilian II carrier strike group, over 120 fighter jets, including JA-35s, J-22s, JA-15s, JA-16s, and additional refuelers and cargo aircraft. Early warning aircraft, including E-3s as well as AWACS, have been moved to airbases in Corzerran and Wuloosya, replied the general.

Strømm opened her mouth and then closed it, before rubbing her mouth with her hand, Corzerran was north of Montfleur, within flight range of Rosenmarkkes northern border, Wuloosya was to the south east across the White strait. 

A veritable sandwich has been created, said Strømm, They intend to attempt a squeeze of our airspace and our borders, 

An excellent assessment madame duc, replied Menkins.

Alright, I want immediate action, but keep it on the down low, mute the radar signatures across this country, begin internet closure protocol, and utilise the passenger rail lines to begin positioning of our SAM defenses, she said.

And the sea? Asked Menkins.

Get our deisel electric subs on patrol within forty-eight hours, I want our EEZ patrolled, and also, issue a NOTAM to all aircraft, were declaring a temporary no-fly zone, Strømm said.

A murmur ran around the room, Wont the citizens be frightened? Asked one of the generals.

Yes, it is why I am directing the SCSID to publish immediately whatever data they have on the forces of the Neue Republik, they need to see the danger to believe it, she replied.

A nod would be sent around the room and she dismissed them.

Due to rising tensions in the region, Rosenmarkke shall hereby be closing its airspace to all foreign traffic for a period of forty-eight hours with potential extension pending review.  All ships entering the Rosenmarkke EEZ shall be required to be escorted by frigate through the EEZ. Minor disruptions to rail and air travel are to be expected but the government remains committed to ensuring all contingencies remain.
